about.subtitle.en: From literature to AI products — building with humanities intuition and technical craft.
about.subtitle.zh: 从文学到 AI 产品——路不是弯的，是我走出来的。

about.intro1.en: I'm an AI product builder with a literature background — I understand users the way you close-read a text, and I understand the world by building things.
about.intro1.zh: 我是学文学的，做 AI 产品。理解用户像细读一篇文本，理解世界靠把东西做出来。

about.intro2.en: My path: Chinese Literature & Communication Studies at Wuhan University, exchange semester at Université Paris Nanterre across 16 countries, and now building AI products at Bestcem (B2B CEM SaaS). Each phase taught me something different — literature gave me sensitivity to language and human nuance, media work taught me platform logic, independent projects proved I can ship from zero, and enterprise SaaS showed me how products survive in the real world.
about.intro2.zh: 武大中文系，辅修传播学。巴黎交换那半年走了 16 个国家。现在在倍市得做 B2B SaaS 的 AI 产品。每一步都教了我不一样的东西——文学给了我对语言和人心的感觉，做媒体让我懂平台怎么运转，独立项目证明我能从零交付，企业 SaaS 让我看到产品在真实世界怎么活。

about.bring1.en: End-to-End AI Product Design: From competitive analysis to PRD to interactive prototype — owned 0-to-1 design for an AI customer journey generator that cuts creation time from hours to minutes
about.bring1.zh: AI 产品从 0 到 1：竞品拆解 → PRD → 交互原型。一个人做完了 AI 客户旅程生成器，把几小时的活压到几分钟

about.bring2.en: User Research at Scale: Led a 17-person team through 1,287 surveys and 3-city fieldwork; report adopted by NetEase product team
about.bring2.zh: 用研：带 17 个人发了 1,287 份问卷，跑了三个城市。报告被网易有道产品组直接采纳

about.bring3.en: LLM Application Development: RAG pipelines (FAISS + embeddings), Function Calling agents, prompt architecture design, multi-model API integration (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Doubao, Anthropic)
about.bring3.zh: LLM 应用开发：RAG 管线、Function Calling Agent、提示词架构设计、多模型 API 集成（OpenAI、DeepSeek、豆包、Anthropic）

about.bring4.en: Full-Stack Prototyping: React/Next.js + Python + RPA — I build working demos, not just mockups
about.bring4.zh: 会写代码：React/Next.js + Python + RPA。我做能跑的东西，不只是画稿

about.bring5.en: Data Pipeline Engineering: Built a 30k+ entry VOC pipeline across 9 platforms with automated collection and cleaning
about.bring5.zh: 数据管线：9 个平台、3 万多条 VOC 数据，从采集到清洗全自动

about.work1.en: Understand "why" before touching "how" — the problem matters more than the solution
about.work1.zh: 先搞清楚「为什么做」再动手——问题比方案重要

about.work2.en: MVP first, iterate fast — ship early, learn from real users, polish what matters
about.work2.zh: MVP 先上，迭代要快——上线了才知道真问题在哪，然后磨该磨的

about.work3.en: Quantify everything, then find the story — data first, narrative gives it meaning
about.work3.zh: 先用数据说话，再讲故事——两样都不能少

about.beyond1.en: 16 countries, 49 cities — I travel not to escape, but to see how differently people live and build. Paris taught me that loving a place and knowing you don't belong to it can coexist.
about.beyond1.zh: 16 个国家，49 座城市。我旅行不是为了逃，是想看看世界上的人都怎么生活、怎么建造。巴黎教会我一件事：爱一个地方，和知道自己不属于那里，这两件事可以同时存在。

about.beyond2.en: I'm also a contracted photographer on Tuchong, trained in sketch and watercolor (Level 9), and I believe the best products — like the best writing — make people feel less alone in the world.
about.beyond2.zh: 我还是图虫签约摄影师，素描和水彩学到亓级。我觉得最好的产品和最好的文学一样——让人在这个世界上不那么孤独。
